name: sandtable
description: Open-source CLI that rehearses AI agents on a simulated copy of a customer's world: simulated callers, stateful mock tools, business rules checked on every tool call, deterministic grading and pass^k.

banner.content: sandtable is in **beta**: the spec and outputs may still change before 1.0. See the [roadmap](/roadmap).

metatags.og:image:alt: sandtable: rehearse your AI agent on a simulated copy of your customer's world. On the same 50 scripted freight calls, a naive agent scores pass^1 10.0%, with 43 calls breaking verify-before-book, 13 rate-ceiling and 9 eligible-carrier, and a careful agent scores 100%.

instructions: sandtable is an open-source CLI in beta (TypeScript, MIT): https://github.com/sandtable-ai/sandtable. Run it as `npx sandtable-ai <command>`, never with the bare name: npm's `sandtable` is an unrelated package. If a flag here disagrees with `npx sandtable-ai <command> --help`, trust the help output.
Grading is deterministic: pass/fail comes from the world's end state, invariants and the tool-call log, never from an LLM judge.
To draft a domain for a user, read /guides/init and /reference/spec, then run `npx sandtable-ai validate`, `lint` and `review` before any model-backed run. Keep all example data fictional.
In Claude Code, the sandtable plugin teaches these steps as skills: `/plugin marketplace add sandtable-ai/sandtable`, then `/plugin install sandtable@sandtable`.

Every page is available as Markdown by appending .md to its URL. /llms.txt lists every page, /llms-full.txt contains the whole site, and https://sandtable.dev/mcp is a search MCP server for these docs.
